description: This file implements a FastAPI web application demonstrating WebSocket communication with an HTML frontend. It includes endpoint definitions, WebSocket handling, and a simple chat interface.

methods.name: get()
methods.description: HTTP GET endpoint returning an HTML page for the WebSocket chat interface.

methods.name: get_cookie_or_token( websocket: WebSocket, session: Annotated[str | None, Cookie()] = None, token: Annotated[str | None, Query()] = None, )
methods.description: Dependency that retrieves a session cookie or query token from WebSocket connection parameters; raises exception if neither is provided.

methods.name: websocket_endpoint( *, websocket: WebSocket, item_id: str, q: int | None = None, cookie_or_token: Annotated[str, Depends(get_cookie_or_token)], )
methods.description: WebSocket endpoint handling messages for a specific item ID, echoing received messages along with session or token info.
